intent: Populate the app's own projects + change_requests + cycle_items + notifications with the real workload Darrell and Christina are carrying on 2026-05-25. This is the §12.5 'PoeTech central runs the same loop on its own instance' pattern. Dispositions stay in non-punitive vocabulary: 'pending', 'approved', 'deferred-next-cycle'. 'rejected' is NEVER used in seeded dispositions.

projects.title: Trust ownership architecture
projects.description_md:
Q1 + Q2 v2-schema answer: TLC, Poe Properties, and PoeTech all carry parent_instance_id = trust.id. Trust is an instance of instance_type='trust'; operating companies hang under it via parent_instance_id. legal_structure_notes jsonb holds the non-privileged admin shape (trustees, successor trustee, EIN last 4, state of formation, registered agent).

Privileged legal content lives encrypted in the Legal domain (v2.6).

priority_factors.urgency_basis: post-vacation; lawyer verify needed before legal_structure_notes go live
priority_factors.task: user/lawyer verify legal structure notes per disclaimer pattern
